meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为穴居人格式以节省输入令牌
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用自然语言文件记录上下文，想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into caveman format to save input tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use natural language files for context and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将自然语言记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md、待办事项、偏好设置）压缩成原始人风格，减少输入 token。压缩版覆盖原文件，可读备份保存为 FILE.original.md。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-compress 文件路径”或“压缩记忆文件”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会询问具体文件路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compress natural language memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to reduce input tokens. The compressed version overwrites the original, and a human-readable backup is saved as FILE.original.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or "compress memory file".

say_en.note: Claude will ask for the file path.
